findings.description: Argument.get_help_record now returns (metavar, self.help) unconditionally. The new return type is tuple[str, str], but self.help is None when the argument has no help text.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command where one argument has help and another does not. The old code in format_arguments substituted (metavar, "") via `or`, but that fallback was removed. The record is now (metavar, None), and formatter.write_dl will likely fail on the None description (for example in wrap_text or len) and raise during --help. The docstring says an empty description is returned, which the code does not do.
